description_en: Adds a third party to an ongoing call
description_zh: 将第三方加入到通话中
name: JoinThirdCall

parameters.help_en: The unique client request ID for idempotence checks. You can use a UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS). You can find this on the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The agent account name (agent logon name)
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称（坐席登录名）
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The acid from the WebSocket after an inbound call is received
parameters.name: call_id

parameters.help_en: The jobId from the WebSocket after an inbound call is received
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The connId from the WebSocket after an inbound call is received
parameters.name: connection_id

parameters.help_en: The holdConnId from the WebSocket after an inbound call is received. This parameter is required only for a two-step transfer
parameters.help_zh: 入呼后，websocket中的holdConnId（ 仅在双步转时传入）
parameters.name: hold_connection_id
